card.name: Words just before pharmacokinetic interaction results
card.fires_on: Words in drug-interaction study descriptions that come right before the study drug or its pharmacokinetics, such as "the", "dose", "days", "interaction" and the start of "coadministered". It fires inside the sentence, before the drug name or the measured effect.

modes.label: Dose wording before drug name
modes.description: The word dose, doses or days after an amount, just before the drug being studied.
modes.example: the administration of a single 600 mg<< dose>> of quinine sulfate with grapefruit juice

modes.label: Linking word before pharmacokinetics
modes.description: The word "the" after "affect" and just before pharmacokinetics.
modes.example: did not significantly affect<< the>> pharmacokinetics of either citalop

modes.label: Inside coadministration
modes.description: The middle piece of "coadministered" or "coadministration" in interaction tables and text.

card.plain: It marks the point in a drug-interaction study sentence where the drug name or the measured effect comes next.
